title: Enable Person Accounts
when: The step asks to switch on Person Accounts for the org from the Person Accounts settings page. It can never be switched off again. It is not creating a person account record and not configuring record types.
steps: On the Person Accounts page, tick each acknowledgement that the prerequisites are met.
Click 'Turn on Person Accounts' (or 'Enable'), and confirm.
doneWhen: The Person Accounts page shows the feature as enabled.
notes: Untested. Irreversible, and it has prerequisites a fresh org does not meet: an Account record type, Contact sharing 'Controlled by Parent', and read access to Contacts on every profile that reads Accounts.
